text: {"lessons":["My account has stayed near its starting value overall, but monthly swings still matter when these savings support retirement; I should favor stability over trying to time the market.","I sold Stock D at gains and Stock C at losses, so I should base each trade on the holding’s prospects and my overall risk plan—not just its price relative to my cost.","After Stock C fell, I sold a much larger amount; before making a sizable trade, I should pause and check that it is a considered decision rather than a reaction to recent losses."]}
